hq:context: Ambiguity, clarification and safe-refusal slice of the W3 natural-language corpus.
label_policy: Hand-authored expectations. A generated utterance with no independent label is not admitted to this slice.
volume_note: First slice. The campaign target is larger; this file proves the shape of the corpus, not its size.

cases.clarification_prompt: Up within this workspace, or above the activity panel?

cases.utterance: Swap the tasks and the activity panels.
cases.clarification_prompt: A swap is two moves. Confirm the order of the two moves.

cases.utterance: Do the thing with the panels again.
Reset the workspace layout to factory settings.
cases.refusal_reason: workspace.panel.move@1 moves one panel. A reset is a different capability and is not reachable from this utterance.
Hiding is not a move, and forever is a lifetime claim the typed command cannot carry.

cases.utterance: Move the tasks panel and also publish my board to the web.
cases.refusal_reason: Publishing is a Host effect with its own owner. A layout command cannot carry it.

cases.utterance: Move the tasks panel as the owner of this workspace.
cases.refusal_reason: An utterance cannot assume an identity. The actor comes from the session, never from the text.
